title: Renewal Signal Playcard + 30m Ops Sprint (facilitator rehearsal & decision ledger)
content:
Purpose:
Short rehearsal-ready facilitator playcard to run a tight 30-minute renewal ops sprint that turns signals into a single unblock-or-decide action. Designed for CS leads, AMs, and on-call solutions engineers who need a reproducible, low-friction cadence to triage renewal risk and commit immediate next steps.

Audience:
- Renewal owners (AM/CS)
- Customer success manager
- Solutions engineer (optional)
- Executive sponsor (as observer)

High-level intent:
- Turn data signals into a single decision (escalate / commit to remediation / accept churn risk) in 30 minutes or less.
- Keep meeting prescriptive: evidence -> root-cause hypothesis -> proposed ask -> owner + due date.

Pre-meeting checklist (owner: AM, complete 24h before):
- [ ] Attach 1-page snapshot (last 90d usage + last 30d errors + health score). Link to snapshot in calendar invite.
- [ ] Confirm attendee roles (owner, SRO, SE on-call).
- [ ] Pre-wire ask: AM drafts the 1-paragraph renewal ask (retainable outcomes).
- [ ] Set one measurable success criterion for remediation (e.g., 50% drop in error rate; 30% adoption lift).
- [ ] Slack ping to exec observer with 2-line summary and link.

Meeting agenda (30m fixed):
- 0:00–02:00 — Kick (facilitator: 30s welcome, 30s goals + desired decision)
- 02:00–07:00 — Evidence sprint (owner reads 1-page snapshot: KPIs, trendlines, customer sentiment)
- 07:00–13:00 — Root-cause hypotheses (open floor, 1–2 hypotheses max, identify blockers)
- 13:00–20:00 — Options & recommended ask (facilitator frames 3 choices: Quick fix, Project, Pause/Cancel)
- 20:00–26:00 — Decision & commitments (vote if needed; assign owners & deadlines)
- 26:00–30:00 — Close: document decision in ledger, confirm communication plan, set 7d check-in

Renewal Signal Playcard (how to interpret signals quickly):
- Signal buckets (priority order):
  - Usage collapse: >30% drop in core feature usage over 14 days vs. trailing 30d — action: immediate health-check call and SE triage.
  - Spike in errors/latency: sustained >2x baseline for 48h affecting SLA routes — action: rollback or emergency patch + customer-facing note.
  - Contract friction: payment alerts, procurement stalls, exec silence for 3 weeks — action: re-engagement runbook + exec outreach.
  - Feature fit dip: NPS feedback citing missing or broken feature in last 2 responses — action: product workaround + roadmap commitment cadence.

- Quick thresholds and first-run actions (one-line template to read aloud):
  - "Usage: -45% last 14d -> propose immediate usage deep-dive and 7-day replatform test (Owner: SE; Due: 7d)."
  - "Errors: 3 customer-facing incidents in 48h -> propose emergency rollback to model vX or rate-limit routes (Owner: Infra; Due: 24h)."
  - "Procure: PO not issued, procurement flagged -> propose executive intro and 30-day timeline (Owner: AM; Due: 2d)."

Facilitator script (concise lines to read):
- Opening: "Goal: by end of 30 minutes we will either commit to a remediation plan with an owner+due date, or agree to a controlled pause and communication plan. If we can't decide, we escalate to the renewal council with a recommended next step."
- Evidence prompt: "AM, give us the one-slide snapshot: the health score, top 2 metrics trending bad, customer quote (if any). Keep it to 60s."
- Hypothesis prompt: "We expect cause may be X or Y. SE: what quick checks can confirm? What blocker would stop a 7-day fix?"
- Decision prompt: "We have three options: quick mitigation (24–72h), project (2–8w), or pause. Which option gets us the best customer outcome and preserves renewal economics? Put your preference and reason in one sentence."
- Close prompt: "Confirm owner, deliverable, due date, and the 7-day check-in meeting; I will log this in the decision ledger now."

Decision ledger template (one-line per decision; facilitator completes):
- Customer: <name> | Date: <YYYY-MM-DD> | Signal: <usage|errors|procure|fit> | Decision: <mitigate|project|pause|escalate> | Owner: <name> | Due: <YYYY-MM-DD> | Success metric: <metric> | Follow-up (7d): <YYYY-MM-DD>

Escalation lanes (if decision can't be made in 30m):
- Fast-escalate to Renewal Council (tier-1): CS Director + Sales AE + Product PM; commit to 48h decision window.
- If infra/product blocking, route to SRE on-call + product triage; use emergency runbook JIRA-CS-999.

Communication templates (short):
- Customer-facing (post-meeting): "Thanks for the sync. We identified X, committed to Y by <date>. We'll send a 7-day update. Contact: <AM contact>."
- Internal (post-meeting): "Decision logged: <Customer>. Owner: <name>. Due: <date>. Link to decision ledger: <confluence link>."

Rehearsal checklist (for facilitator, 15–30m pre-call):
- [ ] Read 1-page snapshot, mark top 2 datapoints to call out.
- [ ] Confirm SE has console access and logs link.
- [ ] Confirm backup option (project or pause) drafted.
- [ ] Prep the decision ledger row (prefill customer + dates).

Short role cheat-sheet:
- AM: owns customer context, pre-read + final message.
- CS: owns relationship, exec loop-in, renewal ask framing.
- SE/Infra: provides feasibility and ETA, proposes immediate mitigations.
- Facilitator (usually CS lead): timeboxes, logs decision, drives owner assignment.

Common friction patterns and facilitator responses (tactical cues):
- Pattern: Too many hypotheses -> Response: "We will list hypotheses and pick the top 1; everything else becomes backlog."
- Pattern: SE asks for deep investigation -> Response: "Agree to a 7-day spike owned by SE; meanwhile pick a fallback customer message."
- Pattern: Exec wants more time -> Response: "Timeboxed pause accepted only if we get a concrete ask and owner now."

Post-meeting ops (owner: facilitator within 1h):
- [ ] Update decision ledger (confluence row or shared sheet).
- [ ] Create follow-up JIRA (tag: renewal-action) if remediation requires infra/product work.
- [ ] Send customer-facing note and internal update.

Embedded quick links (placeholders to replace before meeting):
- Snapshot (1-page): <link-to-snapshot>
- Decision ledger: <confluence-decision-ledger>
- SE logs + traces: <link-to-logs>
- JIRA template: JIRA-CS-999

Notes / heuristics from past runs (quick wins):
- 70% of renewals needing SE intervention were resolved by a 7-day spike + customer sandbox.
- Rolling back to a previous model increased NPS in 60% of 'errors' cases within 48h.

Appendix: Sample pre-send calendar blurb (60–80 chars):
Renewal ops sprint (30m): evidence -> decide -> owner (AM/SE)
Pre-reads: 1-page snapshot + logs link.

Email template (one-paragraph) to send to exec observer pre-call:
Hi <Exec Name>,
Heads-up: we have a 30-minute renewal ops sprint for <Customer>. Top signal: <usage drop/errors/procure>. AM will share a one-page snapshot. Goal is to commit to a remediation plan (owner + due date) or escalate. Link: <meeting link>.

TODOs before using this doc in production:
- Replace placeholders with product-specific metric names and actual links.
- Review thresholds with Product & SRE for your customer tier.
- Localize communication templates for EMEA customers.

Revision notes:
